atlas-lu.0125: A PhD employed by the University of Luxembourg or a public institute (LIST, LIH, LISER) comes as a researcher with full social security; one on a foreign grant comes as a student, limited to 15 hours of other work.
atlas-lu.0127: Luxembourg has working-holiday agreements only with Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Canada, Chile, South Korea and Taiwan.
atlas-lu.0128: Only for citizens of Australia, New Zealand and Japan aged 18 to 30, or Canada, Chile, South Korea and Taiwan aged 18 to 35: a 12-month D visa, not renewable, with annual quotas.
atlas-lu.0130: Up to 90 days in any 180: meetings, negotiations and fairs are allowed, productive work is not.
atlas-lu.0131: No one who entered for a short stay can apply for a work, study or internship permit from inside Luxembourg: the application is inadmissible.
atlas-lu.0134: Hotels and short-term rentals cannot be your registered address, and a room “sans domiciliation” risks a false registration, punished with 1 month to 3 years in prison. Since 1 August 2024 a deposit is capped at 2 months’ rent and agency fees are split 50:50 with the landlord; each bedroom needs at least 9 m² per occupant.
atlas-lu.0135: Get the temporary residence authorisation from the Directorate of Immigration before you enter: you cannot apply from inside the country, even after a visa-free entry. Then get the D visa if you need one (€50). Bring a criminal record under 3 months old, apostilled and translated into French, German or English.
atlas-lu.0136: Declare your arrival at the town hall’s population office within 8 days, with ID and a registered lease or the owner’s accommodation statement. It is free, and you get a stamped receipt.
atlas-lu.0137: Declare your arrival at the town hall within 3 working days of entering, with passport, authorisation, D visa and lease. It is free.
atlas-lu.0138: Within 3 months, register at the town hall with your work contract, or as a student your enrolment, funds and insurance: the registration certificate is issued on the spot, free, and does not expire.
atlas-lu.0139: Within 30 days, have the medical check: a GP visit (about €56 to €65) and a free chest X-ray for tuberculosis at the Ligue Médico-Sociale; without the health certificate the permit is refused.
atlas-lu.0140: Within 3 months of arriving, apply to the Directorate of Immigration for the residence card, with the arrival declaration, proof of the €80 fee and proof of housing; you are then called for photo and fingerprints.
atlas-lu.0141: Your employer declares you to the social security centre (CCSS) within 8 days of starting, which generates your 13-digit national number in 1 to 3 weeks.
atlas-lu.0142: The tax office then issues your withholding tax card; if it is not ready for your first payslip, your employer must withhold a flat 33%, recovered on later payslips or with the annual statement.
atlas-lu.0143: The health card (CNS) arrives by post 3 to 6 weeks after you are registered. Until your national number is active, pay doctors and pharmacies in full, keep the receipted bills and send them to the CNS for a refund.
atlas-lu.0144: Nothing to renew: the registration certificate does not expire.
atlas-lu.0145: A false address declaration leads to removal from the register, loss of the permit and expulsion, besides fines of €251 to €12,500.
atlas-lu.0146: If your employer has no tax card for your first salary, 33% is withheld; plan on €6,000 to €7,000 of cash for the first month (rent, two months’ deposit, agency fee and health costs paid up front).
atlas-lu.0147: Hotels and Airbnb cannot be declared as your address, and a flat with fewer than 9 m² of bedroom per person blocks registration.
atlas-lu.0148: A false address registration can cost the permit and lead to a prison term of one month to three years and a fine of €251 to €12,500.
atlas-lu.0149: Until your social-security number is active, pay doctors in full and keep the stamped receipts to claim back from the CNS.
atlas-lu.0150: Cross-border workers living in France, Belgium or Germany: working more than 34 days a year outside Luxembourg makes all those days taxable at home.
atlas-lu.0151: The next automatic wage indexation, raising the minimum wage and the thresholds linked to it, is expected in spring or summer 2027.
atlas-lu.0152: A reform would replace the tax classes with a single neutral class.
atlas-lu.0153: The severe-shortage list for 2027, which decides the five-day ADEM route, has not yet been published.
atlas-lu.0154: Some landlords still rent single rooms without the head tenant’s consent, and communes then refuse registration.
